settings.description: The knowledge store Keystone remembers in. With none, Keystone keeps your chats and remembers nothing between them. The built-in store keeps what it remembers in your own Keystone folder. Waymarks is your own Waymarks instance, at the address and with the tokens you give.
Where your Waymarks instance is, such as http://127.0.0.1:7878. Its tokens are kept with your secrets and never here.
How long Keystone waits for one answer from Waymarks before it carries on without it, from 100ms to 2m.
The most results one search of Waymarks returns when the search names no limit, from 1 to 100.
The most pages Keystone asks Waymarks for at once when it lists the pages needing a vector, from 1 to 1000.
The largest answer Keystone reads from Waymarks, in megabytes, from 1 to 1024. A larger one is treated as Waymarks being unavailable.
The most results one search of the built-in knowledge store returns when the search names no limit, from 1 to 1000.
About how many words of a matching page or source a result from the built-in knowledge store shows, from 1 to 64.
The most pages the built-in knowledge store lists at once as needing a vector, from 1 to 10000.
